domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers, including normalization, denominator matching, borrowing, subtraction, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite given numbers into a subtraction-ready representation, including normalizing improper mixed numbers and expressing whole numbers with a zero fractional part so whole and fractional parts are aligned.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because normalization is a distinct setup skill with different error patterns from denominator matching and from later execution steps.

skills.name: Establish common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and apply a common denominator by rewriting fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators are unlike.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because denominator matching is an independent preparatory operation with strong diagnostic value and does not always co-occur with normalization.

skills.name: Subtract and regroup fractional/whole parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction of aligned whole and fractional parts, including subtracting numerators over a common denominator and regrouping by borrowing across a mixed number when the fractional part of the minuend is insufficient.
skills.merge_rationale: Merged because borrowing is not a separate phase from subtraction in these items; it is a contingent continuation of the subtraction process when an initial fractional difference is negative or insufficient. S04 also has S03 as a prerequisite, indicating a tight dependency.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction result to a whole number or 0 after subtraction.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because simplification has distinct post-subtraction error patterns and does not always occur.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine computed whole and fractional parts and express the result in final form as a mixed number, fraction, integer, or 0.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because final composition is a presentation/integration step that is diagnostically different from simplification; some items require one without the other.
